title: Get a permit to film on council land
what: Get the council's permit before commercial filming or photography on roads, parks or other council land.

laws.title: Local Government Act 1993 New South Wales

sources.title: Approval for filming council of the city of sydney
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You may need this approval to direct, produce or conduct filming activities in a public area.

triggers.note: it films on roads, parks or other council land

reach.condition: if it films on roads, parks or other council land
